description: One look at a pid through the process facts crate, the reading the Rust judge decides from. The Node payload asks it where it has no process table of its own to read: on Windows, the creation time (FILETIME, decimal) of a process. It signals nothing and changes nothing.

stdout.startTime: string, only for live: the start time the OS reports (Linux: /proc stat field 22; Windows: creation FILETIME)
stdout.cause: string, only for unreadable: driver-missing, permission or timeout

exitCodes.0: answered (the state field carries the answer, including absent and unreadable)

invariants: unreadable is never reported as absent: a pid whose facts cannot be read stays unknown to the caller
